name: direct_read
semantics: L9 directly reads the local array L1. Unit graph edges are hand-specified assumptions, not compiler output.

name: direct_write
semantics: L9 writes L1 before the array is returned through an output copy.

name: nested_loops
semantics: L19 is inside L9, with sparse absolute identities.

name: different_arrays
semantics: L9 only accesses L1, L19 only accesses L3. No relationship is established across the other loop/array; no general independence claim.

name: shared_helper
semantics: Two different call sites pass different buffers to the same helper. The unit input omits callsite metadata deliberately. No positional binding is accepted as call-specific proof.

name: bound_helper
semantics: Positive unit case with explicit originating callsite and formal-root access. The real legacy generator cannot emit the new field; real compilation must remain conservative even when source semantics establish the helper access.

name: resolved_view
semantics: Memory view of L1 has a compiler-resolved root in the unit input. Real C++ pointer offset lowering is inspected, not presumed to produce a particular memref opcode.

name: dependencies
semantics: A proven RAW edge qualifies; an unresolved reverse edge must not qualify. Unit certainty is explicitly specified. Real compiler certainty is reported as observed, not assigned from this fixture.
